notes: *Of ... were* is the prepositional predicate's under rule 49; the only other nominal, מַחְלְקוֹת, is the clause's English subject, which rule 49's closing paragraph makes decisive.
*even* stands before a phrase no object marker marks and is not one of rule 16's *even unto* expansions, so it is added.

*having* is marked added on rule 20's boundary: the appositional noun מִשְׁמָרוֹת licenses its own English word but not a predication, and rule 43 finds nothing in the clause to make it possessive; the competing reading takes *having offices* whole onto that noun.
The marginal alternative *wards over against their brethren* was read and set aside under rule 38.
